name: cf-deploy-status
description: Self-hosted Cloudflare Workers/Pages deployment notifications and reconciliation.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID used for Pages polling and optional Workers reconciliation.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Account-scoped read-only Cloudflare API token. Grant only the read permissions needed by the monitors you enable.

INGEST_SHARED_SECRET.description: Random bearer token protecting CI ingestion and synthetic test endpoints. Generate a long random value.

PAGES_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional secret shared with a Cloudflare Pages generic webhook notification.

DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional Discord incoming webhook URL. Configure at least one Discord, Slack, or generic destination.

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional Slack incoming webhook URL. Configure at least one Discord, Slack, or generic destination.

GENERIC_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional generic JSON webhook destination. Configure at least one Discord, Slack, or generic destination.

GENERIC_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional bearer token attached to generic webhook deliveries.
